Pricing

Acme costs $9 a month for one person, or $29 a month for a studio.

Solo

Solo is for one freelancer. It includes unlimited invoices, automatic reminders for late payments, receipt capture with your phone, card and bank transfer payments, and a yearly export for your accountant. You can cancel at any time from the billing page and keep read access to every invoice you sent.

Studio

Studio is for small teams of up to five people. It adds shared clients, branded invoices with your logo and colours, approval before an invoice goes out, and one combined export for the whole team. Each extra person after five costs $6 a month.

Questions

Every plan starts with a 14-day trial. You can switch plans at any time and the price changes from the next billing date. Prices are in US dollars and exclude sales tax where it applies.
